banner.title: Banner A
banner.message_optin: We use cookies and similar technologies for two optional purposes. Statistics: Google Analytics counts visits and page views, so we can see how the shop is used. Google Ireland Limited processes this data for us, and it may be transferred to Google LLC in the USA. Marketing: we record which website, campaign or link brought you here and keep that note with an inquiry you send us. Both purposes stay off until you accept. If you reject, the shop works the same. You can change your choice at any time under “Cookie settings” at the foot of every page.

functional_text.text: Keeps the shop working: your session, your solution draft, your sign-in, your language and this cookie choice. These are always on.

statistics_text.text: Google Analytics (Google Ireland Limited; transfer to Google LLC in the USA possible). It sets the cookies _ga and _ga_… for 400 days and shows us how the shop is used.

marketing_text.text: Our own record of where your visit came from (the referring website, campaign or link). The sbjs_… cookies are stored for your visit: most end when you close the browser, sbjs_session 30 minutes after your last page view. The note goes with an inquiry you send us and is not passed to anyone else.
